verses.text: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers.

xrefs.text: I do not sit with deceitful men, nor keep company with hypocrites.
Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evildoers.
He who walks with the wise will become wise, but the companion of fools will be destroyed.
Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.
I never sat with the band of revelers, nor did I celebrate with them. Because Your hand was on me, I sat alone, for You have filled me with indignation.

verses.text: But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, and on His law he meditates day and night.

xrefs.text: This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in all you do.
If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
For in my inner being I delight in God’s law.
Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.

verses.text: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.

xrefs.text: He is like a tree planted by the waters that sends out its roots toward the stream. It does not fear when the heat comes, and its leaves are always green. It does not worry in a year of drought, nor does it cease to produce fruit.

Along both banks of the river, fruit trees of all kinds will grow. Their leaves will not wither, and their fruit will not fail. Each month they will bear fruit, because the water from the sanctuary flows to them. Their fruit will be used for food and their leaves for healing.”
In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,
If anyone does not remain in Me, he is like a branch that is thrown away and withers. Such branches are gathered up, thrown into the fire, and burned.
Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard, planted by the water; it was fruitful and full of branches because of the abundant waters.

verses.text: Not so the wicked! For they are like chaff driven off by the wind.

xrefs.text: Are they like straw before the wind, like chaff swept away by a storm?
His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the LORD drives them away.
The nations rage like the rush of many waters. He rebukes them, and they flee far away, driven before the wind like chaff on the hills, like tumbleweeds before a gale.
Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the early dew that vanishes, like chaff blown from a threshing floor, like smoke through an open window.

verses.text: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

xrefs.text: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.
And they will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.
So you will again distinguish between the righteous and the wicked, between those who serve God and those who do not.”
Then He will say to those on His left, ‘Depart from Me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.
So keep watch at all times, and pray that you may have the strength to escape all that is about to happen and to stand before the Son of Man.

verses.text: For the LORD guards the path of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.

xrefs.text: Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity.”
I am the good shepherd. I know My sheep and My sheep know Me,
The LORD detests the way of the wicked, but He loves those who pursue righteousness.
The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress; He cares for those who trust in Him.
The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.
